The Women’s Campaign Fund
Congresswoman Stefanik was among thirteen Democrat and Republican candidates endorsed by the WCF, which "supports competent women candidates who demonstrate they have what it takes to win their races, to find and build on common ground, and to work effectively for the good of all at every level of elected office in the United States."
US Chamber of Commerce
“The U.S. Chamber is proud to endorse Elise Stefanik, who has been an ardent and consistent voice for pro-growth reforms and pro-jobs policies.”
The New York Post
"One of the brightest lights of the New York congressional delegation. Stefanik deserves another term."
NFIB Fed PAC
"As the voice of small business, NFIB knows good small business policy starts with electing good small business candidates. Therefore, your re-election is critical to the small businesses in your district, and we look forward to working with you on the issues most important to them -- health care, regulations, and taxes."
New York State Rifle & Pistol Association
"I have known Elise since she first ran for Congress," said Tom King, President of the New York State Rifle & Pistol Association. "Elise has delivered on her promise to North Country voters to fight to protect the Second Amendment. She is one of New York's strongest defenders of the Second Amendment elected in Congress. She has never wavered on her positions, and took the lead in helping to pass concealed carry reciprocity out of the House of Representatives."
Independence Party of New York
“We are proud to support Congresswoman Stefanik’s re-election campaign for the 21st District,” said Frank MacKay, Chairman of the Independence Party of New York. “From day one, Elise has consistently delivered bipartisan results on behalf of families and small businesses, active duty soldiers and veterans, farmers and all of her constituents across the North Country.”
NTEU
We believe that your victory on November 6th will result in a better understanding of the important contributions federal employees make and services they provide to the American people. I wish you the best of luck in your effort. -- Anthony M. Reardon,  National President
Citizens for Responsible Energy Solutions
“Rep. Elise Stefanik has made focusing on commonsense, clean energy solutions that grow the economy, strengthen America’s national security, and preserve the quality of our natural environment a hallmark of her time in the House. Additionally, Rep. Stefanik has demonstrated a commitment to promoting clean energy technology as a member of the House Clean Energy and Innovation Working Group. CRES is proud to formally endorse Elise Stefanik in her re-election bid for U.S. House in New York’s 21st District,” CRES Managing Director Heather Reams said.
Conservative Party of New York State
From day one, Congresswoman Stefanik has served as a new generation of leadership in Washington, a champion for conservative principles and a firm protector of our Constitutional rights," said Chairman Long. "Elise earned our endorsement for her strong support for the 2nd Amendment, for our small businesses, our veterans and Military service members, and for every hardworking taxpayer in the 21st District. The Conservative Party is proud to endorse Elise Stefanik. Our members look forward to working hard on behalf of her re-election."
New York Reform Party
Congresswoman Stefanik is a tireless advocate for government transparency and accountability who consistently puts the North Country first,” said Capitol Region Reform Party Chairman Pat Southworth. “Elise has earned the Reform Party’s endorsement for her policy driven, bipartisan record of results. She has consistently empowered students and teachers in our classrooms, supported the Second Amendment while championing commonsense safety reforms that protect our schools, and has opposed big government mandates like Common Core and the NY SAFE ACT. We are proud to have Elise’s name on the Reform Party ballot this November.
Winning For Women
“The youngest woman ever elected to Congress, Elise Stefanik has risen quickly as a leader among her peers,” said Winning For Women Executive Director Rebecca Schuller. “Elise has been unwavering in her support of strong national security, securing our borders, and protecting the men and women in uniform who keep our country safe at home and abroad. Additionally, Elise’s efforts to help recruit and develop other women for current and future runs for federal office show her commitment to the next generation of leadership. Winning For Women is proud to endorse this leader and trailblazer.”
NRA
NRA Grade: A
ClearPath Action Fund
Elise [is an] independent leaders who work across the aisle to enable the development of clean energy, which creates jobs and lowers costs," ClearPath Action Fund Founder and CEO Jay Faison said. "[Her] continued leadership is critical to ensuring that we move ahead with a sensible, affordable and diverse set of existing power sources, as well as make the necessary investments to foster innovation that will create the next generation of clean energy power."

Count this newspaper among the Minnesota voices that long for a lessening of partisan polarization and a return to constructive problem-solving in Washington. If demonization of the partisan opposition continues to be the political coin of this realm, effectiveness of American democracy will be diminished.
Independent judgment, exercised on behalf of the best interests of the country and state, is what we hope to see from our U.S. senators. With that hope in mind, this newspaper recommends the reelection of Republican U.S. Sen. Norm Coleman.
The more independent, pragmatic Coleman emerged when he helped speed money to Minneapolis for a new Interstate 35W bridge; when he promoted tax credits for renewable energy investment; when he pushed for larger Pell Grants for needy college students; when he stood up to President Bush on extending publicly subsidized health insurance, including MinnesotaCare, to more poor children and their parents.
He showed good judgment most recently when, despite a tide of constituent opposition, he voted to authorize spending $700 billion to inject capital into banks and thaw a credit freeze. He rightly judged that quick action was needed to avert serious damage to the nation's economy.
St. Paul Pioneer Press

Minneapolis Star Tribune
Count this newspaper among the Minnesota voices that long for a lessening of partisan polarization and a return to constructive problem-solving in Washington. If demonization of the partisan opposition continues to be the political coin of this realm, effectiveness of American democracy will be diminished.
Independent judgment, exercised on behalf of the best interests of the country and state, is what we hope to see from our U.S. senators. With that hope in mind, this newspaper recommends the reelection of Republican U.S. Sen. Norm Coleman.
The more independent, pragmatic Coleman emerged when he helped speed money to Minneapolis for a new Interstate 35W bridge; when he promoted tax credits for renewable energy investment; when he pushed for larger Pell Grants for needy college students; when he stood up to President Bush on extending publicly subsidized health insurance, including MinnesotaCare, to more poor children and their parents.
He showed good judgment most recently when, despite a tide of constituent opposition, he voted to authorize spending $700 billion to inject capital into banks and thaw a credit freeze. He rightly judged that quick action was needed to avert serious damage to the nation's economy.
St. Paul Pioneer Press
Minnesota is fortunate to have three strong candidates vying for the U.S. Senate this year: Norm Coleman, the incumbent Republican; Al Franken, the Demo-cratic-Farmer-Labor challenger; and Dean Barkley, the longtime third-party activist who briefly held the seat in 2002.
We endorse Coleman for a second term, and we want it understood that we are endorsing the "work-across-the-aisle" candidate that he presented to voters. The country will need voices of moderation and unity, particularly as we extricate ourselves from Iraq, and we expect Coleman to deliver on this promise.
We are not blind to Coleman's faults or to the talents of Franken and Barkley. We do not agree with either party's approach to every issue. We know there are those who will vote based purely on those issues or on party allegiance. You don't need our help to do that. We try to get away from the scorecard and look at the candidates in full.
On that basis, we see Coleman as a gifted politician who could help forge a new national consensus without abandoning his conservative principles.
We know him well. He distinguished himself as an energetic, tireless, non-ideological mayor of our city from 1994 to 2002. He was responsible for a coming-together of business and political leaders that put St. Paul first and, yes, brought the National Hockey League back to its rightful "state of hockey.''
Mesabi Daily News
We firmly believe the most important issue this election campaign for the Iron Range is which candidates for state and federal office will work the hardest, and without giving an inch to certain environmental special interest groups, when it comes to helping pave the way for jobs in the region.
U.S. Sen. Norm Coleman has a proven six-year record of working hard in a bipartisan manner for economic development projects in the state and on the Iron Range. We have been especially pleased to see the harmonious working relationship between Minnesota political party Senate opposites Republican Coleman and Democrat Amy Klobuchar for the betterment of the state. That speaks well of both.
Marshall Independent
In breaking with our policy on endorsing political candidates, the Independent will endorse a candidate in the U.S. Senate race. The race is tight, and this election year, it's important to make good choices at the poll.
The Independent endorses Sen. Norm Coleman as the choice to return to the U.S. Senate and represent Minnesota.
Fairmont Sentinel
In the race for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, one candidate is head and shoulders above the rest. That candidate is Norm Coleman, a Republican who is completing his first term.
Coleman is competent, experienced and bipartisan. He has worked across the aisle on issues such as energy - as a member of the Gang of 20 - and yet he has remained his own man on matters of principle. He supported the Bush tax cuts, he has fought against a timetable for withdrawal in Iraq and he has acted to curb abuses at the United Nations.
Coleman does not have his head in the clouds. He has not draped himself in Washington power. He has been a consistent advocate on rural development, transportation and alternative energy; all important issues in his home state. People often say they want their representatives to work together - regardless of party - to get things done. That is what Norm Coleman has done.
Fargo Forum
Sen. Norm Coleman, R-Minn., has earned a second term in the U.S. Senate. The moderate Republican has demonstrated the ability to reach across the political aisle and remain true to his core principles. His opponent, Democrat Al Franken, is a sincere, intelligent candidate but embraces a style of hard-edged liberalism that would hamstring his effectiveness as a senator.
ECM Newspapers
Americans badly want a change in the direction of this country. They yearn for stability in the financial markets and they worry about their own personal finances, retirement, jobs and health care.
They are hungry for leadership that will skillfully, diplomatically and intelligently help them survive an unraveling economy, an unpopular war, a drifting energy policy, higher health care costs and a different strategy to fight terrorism.
This November Minnesotans will elect their U.S. Senator for the next six years. Three men are running for that office now held by Sen. Norm Coleman. Challenging him are Al Franken, endorsed by the Minnesota DFL Party, and Dean Barkley, endorsed by the Minnesota Independence Party.
The ECM Publishers Editorial Board has interviewed all three candidates personally. The board concluded that any of the three men are well qualified to be Minnesota’s U.S. senator. Its decision is to endorse Sen. Coleman for re-election.
New Ulm Journal
In his first term, Minnesota's Sen. Norm Coleman has followed in the tradition of those who have served in the Senate before him. His philosophy may be politically different from the happy liberalism of DFLers Hubert Humphrey, Fritz Mondale and Paul Wellstone, but like all of them, and like Republican David Durenberger, he is a serious senator, a dedicated public servant and a smart, competent legislator.
Albert Lea Tribune
It is one thing to rise within the structure of Minnesota politics and then run for Senate. It is another to be a celebrity and then run for Senate.
Republican incumbent Sen. Norm Coleman was the mayor of St. Paul before running for Senate. He knows Minnesota. Comedian challenger Al Franken definitely is familiar with American politics — he has authored best-selling books — but we doubt whether he is familiar enough with Minnesotans.
Franken indeed grew up in Minnesota and even for a time in Albert Lea. We like that about him.
But we doubt whether Franken would be in the state if it weren’t for his national political aspirations. We suggest he run for local offices before he shoots for the Senate.
McLeod County Chronicle
But the state race with the most attention, and funds, is for the U.S. Senate seat held by U.S. Sen. Norm Coleman, R-Minn. He is being challenged by comedian-turned-politician Al Franken, a Democrat, and former U.S. Sen. Dean Barkley, I-Minn.
From whom Barkley takes votes may determine who wins. Heck, Barkley could even win in an unpredictable three-way race. Minnesotans have been known to be unpredictable at times.
We like Coleman and his experience in the Senate. While his voting record does not indicate his self-proclaimed bipartisan leaning, he is a better option than Franken. We had one Mark Dayton, we don't need another representing Minnesota if Franken wins.
Rochester Post-Bulletin
We endorse Sen. Norm Coleman for another term in the U.S. Senate. We applaud his opposition to drilling in the Alaska National Wildlife Refuge, and we admire the fact that he's played a key role in creating a new national energy policy. We also are impressed with his efforts to make sure that Minnesota's soldiers have all the help they need when they return from service overseas.
In a second term, however, we expect more from Coleman. In our interview with him, we saw a quieter man, a somewhat humbler Norm Coleman than we'd seen before. One who declared that our current crisis demands leaders who put ideology aside to get things done.
He needs to act on that principal. He told us "Health care is a right," and he needs to pursue legislation to make it happen. He told us he opposes unfunded mandates for education, so we expect him to be a major player in a much-needed overhaul of the No Child Left Behind Act.
Coleman has had six years to figure out what's wrong with Washington. There's no reason he can't play a key role in fixing it.

Newspaper Endorsements
The New Mexican
“This is a national-level lawmaker who can – and does – work with allies as well as opponents, with a better nation in mind. His collegial approach to problem-solving is in too-short supply in a Senate long in the stranglehold of partisanship,” wrote the New Mexican.
[snip]
“As New Mexico’s attorney general, his honesty and tough-mindedness made him the leading vote-getter on the state ballot; Republicans and Democrats alike found lots to like about his forthright manner – not to mention his refusal to be bought by the vested interests, and his willingness to prosecute and call attention to ethical lapses by fellow Democrats.”
[snip]
“The 111th Congress faces crises foreign and domestic – maybe even disasters by the time it convenes in January. Its members, especially in the Senate, must be decisive, thoughtful and well-informed. Those qualities, and integrity to boot, are what Tom Udall offers – and New Mexicans should overwhelmingly accept.”
Las Cruces Sun-News
"... we believe he is the best choice in a year when fundamental change is needed in Washington, and one in which New Mexico will be sending four freshmen out of our five-member delegation to represent us in Congress."
Santa Fe Reporter
"[Udall] has stood up for constituents on a variety of fronts."
"As attorney general, Udall was accessible and proactive in facing problems such as DWI, consumer fraud and domestic violence,” the newspaper stated. “He was a voice against the USA Patriot Act and the Iraq War. He supports the State Children’s Health Insurance Program and fought against expanded eavesdropping abilities for US spy agencies. He voted to lower interest rates for college students, to increase the minimum wage and he has been a voluble voice for veterans’ rights."
Las Vegas Optic
"Northern New Mexico knows Tom Udall well. He’s been our Democratic congressman for the last decade and served as a two-term state attorney general before that."
"We enthusiastically recommend Udall’s election as U.S. senator, replacing the longtime incumbent, Pete Domenici."
"Again and again, Udall takes positions that deserve respect. We would be proud to have him as our senator."
Weekly Alibi
"If Rep. Tom Udall is elected as one of New Mexico's two senators, he would bring his brand of moderate pragmatism to the table. He was the state's attorney general in the '90s and has been a congressperson in the House of Representatives since 1998. He's worked on bipartisan efforts to preserve wilderness in New Mexico."
Silver City Daily Press
Says Udall’s Positions “More in Line with the Needs of Southwest New Mexico.”
The newspaper called Udall the better of the two candidates to “stand up for New Mexicans in challenging economic times” and “more in line with the needs of Southwest New Mexico.”
Taos News
His opponent, Steve Pearce, just can’t seem to get past the party line such as his drill-baby-drill solution for the energy crisis. We want an independent-minded senator who sticks to his convictions.
Los Alamos Monitor
Organizational Endorsements
New Mexico Fraternal Order of Police
"Tom Udall has spent his career serving the citizens of New Mexico. He has a proven record of supporting laws that protect our citizens and he has always been a strong supporter of law enforcement. The New Mexico Fraternal Order of Police, building on a proud tradition, is honored to endorse Tom Udall for Senate."
Bill Standridge, NM FOP State President
June 23, 2008
Veterans’ Vision
“The Veterans’ Vision has consistently endorsed Representative Udall since he was elected to serve the New Mexico 3rd district in 1998. Representative Udall, whose family has a long record of public service, has earned a reputation of working hard for veterans.”
June 5, 2008
National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare (NCPSSM)
“Our nation needs your leadership, vision and determination to fight for working families and older Americans. You understand that congressional efforts to privatize Social Security, which would undermine the most successful social insurance program ever, continue. You recognize fully that the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act pulls the plug on Medicare’s universal risk pool and sets the stage for efforts to unravel Medicare through privatization. National Committee members and supporters want you in the United States Senate to continue protecting Social Security and Medicare—the twin pillars necessary to a good quality of life for Americans of all ages.”
Barbara B. Kennelly, President and CEO, NCPSSM
July 2, 2008

Ray M. Baca, Executive Director, NMBCTC

“Here in New Mexico, CVNM (Conservation Voters New Mexico) applauds Rep. Tom Udall (D-3rd) for a perfect score of 100 percent and for his leadership on the energy bill. (Rep. Udall introduced an amendment that would have required utilities to produce at least 15 percent of their electricity from renewable energy sources by 2020.) Rep. Udall's legislation would have saved consumers billions of dollars on their energy bills and created many new green collar jobs here in New Mexico while dramatically slashing global warming pollution. Unfortunately, a minority of senators eventually stripped that important provision from the bill.”
Sandy Buffett, Executive Director, CVNM
February 21, 2008
Defenders of Wildlife
“New Mexico presents a rare opportunity for Americans who care about conservation to increase their ranks in the Senate and House. Representative Tom Udall has a stellar conservation record and we know he’d be a true champion for New Mexico in the Senate. Conversely, Representatives Steve Pearce and Heather Wilson both have atrocious conservation records. They both sit on House committees that are vital to our nation’s conservation efforts, yet both have voted repeatedly to provide tax breaks to polluting industries and undermine key laws that protect our air, land and water.”
Rodger Schlickeisen, President, Action Fund

Dear Representative Marino:
On behalf of our six million members across the country, the National Rifle Association Political Victory Fund (NRA-PVF) is proud to endorse your candidacy for the U.S. House of Representatives in the 12th Congressional District of Pennsylvania in the November 6, 2018 general election.
Thank you for standing strong for freedom and defending NRA members and law-abiding gun owners in Pennsylvania and throughout the United States. Based on your consistent and proven voting record on Second Amendment issues in the U.S. House of Representatives, you have earned an “A” rating from NRA-PVF for this election. An “A” rating is reserved for a solidly pro-gun legislator who has supported NRA positions on key votes and issues.
As a member of the House Committee on the Judiciary, you helped bring concealed carry reciprocity legislation to the House floor and voted for its passage. This bill is the strongest piece of self-defense legislation to ever come before Congress and would ensure that the nearly 20 million law-abiding Americans who can carry a concealed firearm in their home state are able to do so in any other state that does not prohibit it.
NRA members and Pennsylvania hunters appreciate your vote for the Sportsmen’s Heritage and Recreation Enhancement (SHARE) Act, a bill that would benefit sportsmen in Pennsylvania and throughout the country.
In addition, we applaud your votes to strike down an Obama-era regulation that stripped Social Security recipients of their Second Amendment rights without due process, and for legislation to protect veterans’ Second Amendment rights.
Finally, your dedication to protecting our right to keep and bear arms is demonstrated by your opposition to the Pelosi/Schumer/Bloomberg gun control agenda of banning guns, ammunition, magazines, and creating a so-called
universal” background check system that would criminalize the private transfer of firearms, which, according to the Obama Department of Justice, is only enforceable through federal firearms registration.
Congratulations on your “A” rating and endorsement, and thank you for your steadfast support of the Second Amendment. Good luck with your campaign, and we look forward to our continued relationship.
Sincerely, Dan w.am Chris W. Cox

Oregon's papers agree: Ron Wyden for Senate
Newspapers from across Oregon are in agreement: Ron Wyden is the unrivaled choice in the race for Senate. Click on the images below to read full endorsements from papers across Oregon.
The Hillsboro Argus
"This could come as a surprise to our regular readers. We endorse Ron Wyden for Oregon's Senator. Yes he's a part of the Washington establishment. But he's not a lock step participant in what goes down on Capitol Hill. Yes, he is a Democrat. But you need to see past a party affiliation. See what's best for the state. He has tenure, knows the turf and knows Oregon - our opportunities and challenges."
Read the full endorsement
The Oregonian
"Wyden is running strong in this election because he has a keen sense of what it means to represent an entire state, urban and rural. Oregon voters everywhere would benefit from Ron Wyden's re-election to the U.S. Senate."
The Daily Astorian
"U.S. Sen. Ron Wyden has matured and grown over his long career that began in 1980 with election to the House of Representatives...
[...]
"Here at the mouth of the Columbia River, Wyden has secured funds for repairing the jetties. He has also obtained appropriations that have benefitted alternative fuel research for Lektro Inc., for infrastructure improvement at Camp Rilea and to boost our county's emergency preparedness communications network."
The Portland Tribune
and other Community Newspapers
"Democrat Ron Wyden has been in the U.S. Senate just long enough to begin building influence that will be helpful for Oregon. And during his time in office – both as a senator and previously as a member of the House of Representatives – he has grown toward a political moderation that will serve him well in a body that’s likely to be more closely divided between Democrats and Republicans following the Nov. 2 election."
Willamette Week
"... Wyden is honest, energetic and increasingly influential after 14 years in the Senate. He’s been at the forefront of congressional battles on issues important to his constituents: from local issues such as securing federal timber payments to rural counties to national topics such as whether to tax Internet commerce (he’s consistently opposed such a tax) and how to make health care cheaper."
Bend's
Source Weekly
"The decision in the U.S. Senate race in Oregon is as close to a no-brainer as it can get. Ron Wyden has given us 14 years of distinguished service in the Senate, and his opponent, Jim Huffman, has given us no reason that he should replace him.
"Wyden’s campaign slogan says he’s “Different. Like Oregon.” While he’s not a wild-eyed maverick by any means, Wyden has been willing to buck the Washington majority, and his own party, when conscience and common sense said he should. He voted against the foolish and unnecessary invasion of Iraq and against both Wall Street bailout bills – the first one proposed by President Bush in 2008 and the second one backed by President Obama."
Medford's
Mail Tribune
"In an election year as partisan and divisive as any in recent memory, U.S. Sen. Ron Wyden stands out as a different kind of politician. His bipartisan approach and his continual focus on what is best for Oregon causes us to recommend voters return him to office for a third six-year term."
Eugene Weekly
"Wyden, skilled at working across the Senate, has been a big player in health care, a forest policy both industry and environmentalists can agree to, and trying to rein in Wall Street. He voted against the Iraq War, a powerful vote we value."
Portland's
The Skanner
"We appreciate the work our incumbent lawmakers have done on the national level, especially the pro-veteran efforts of U.S. Sen. Ron Wyden and District 3 Rep. Earl Blumenauer (both of whom typically make themselves available to reporters at The Skanner News and actually show up regularly in Northeast Portland)."
Eugene's
The Register Guard
"In a third term, Wyden will have accumulated enough seniority and influence to begin building a legacy, much as former Oregon Sens. Mark Hatfield and Bob Packwood did with wilderness and tax reform, respectively. Having someone in Congress with enough clout to defend timber counties’ claim to continued payments is reason enough to re-elect Wyden. But a third term should give Wyden an opportunity to reach higher — a chance to harness what he calls “idea-driven government” to a few really big ideas."
Salem's
Statesman Journal
"Like other Americans, Oregonians can find many reasons to criticize Congress as dysfunctional. But Ron Wyden is a powerful voice for Oregon and someone whose bipartisanship sets a positive example for his colleagues and the country."
Read the full endorsement here.
Pendleton's
East Oregonian
"Wyden... is a knowledgeable leader who has stepped across the aisle on the most important issues facing our nation and our state... We strongly urge a vote for Sen. Wyden."
Baker City Herald
"During his 14 years as one of Oregon’s two U.S. senators, Wyden has shown a proclivity for, if not exactly defying his party, then at least taking up causes which veer away from Democratic orthodoxy.
"Which is why we recommend voters — including those aligned with that aforementioned “R” — re-elect Wyden for six more years.
"Wyden’s advocacy over more than a decade has been crucial in ensuring that the federal government compensates Baker County for the drastic decline in timber revenue that resulted, in part, from changes in federal forest policy."
The Dalles Chronicle
" Through helping bring Google to The Dalles, advocating for a sensible salvage logging program that would benefit Eastern Oregon, supporting the will of the voters in the state’s assisted suicide law, helping retain vital — and promised — federal replacement dollars to sustain Oregon counties, meeting face to face with voters in every county every year, Ron Wyden has worked well in serving constituents, including those in rural Oregon. "
Corvallis Gazette Times
"The reason is that Wyden has been a fairly effective senator - and he benefits from an independent streak that doesn't do him any harm among the Oregon electorate. The Gazette-Times endorses Wyden for re-election. Huffman talks a good game about being independent and keeping a lid on government spending. But those aren't issues that will leave much of a mark on Wyden, who ticked off his fellow Democrats by opposing bailouts for Wall Street two years ago."
The La Grande Observer
"Ron Wyden has represented Oregon in the U.S. Senate since 1996, and deserves to be sent back for another six-year term. He is a strong advocate of health care reform, energy independence, consumer protection and senior citizen issues.
"What’s more, [Wyden] is growing in power. He is the chairman of the subcommittees on public lands and forests and international trade, customs and global competitiveness. His experience pays dividends for Oregon in these vital areas.
"Wyden also makes effort to listen to his constituents. During his time in office, Wyden has hosted more than 550 town hall meetings, visiting each county at least once a year."

73rd Governor of the Commonwealth of Virginia
I’m proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.
As Governor, I saw Abigail’s incredible commitment to the Seventh District of Virginia and Virginia as a whole. I saw an effective leader, and I saw someone who never stopped working to deliver results.
Abigail is also a very impressive listener. And because she truly listens to our neighbors, Abigail will remain focused on the issues that matter most — creating jobs, investing in our schools, lowering drug prices, protecting our natural resources, defending the rights of all Virginians, and returning Virginia to being the number-one state for business. I have no doubt that our Commonwealth will prosper under the steady leadership of Abigail Spanberger.”
U.S. Rep. Jennifer Wexton (VA-10)
Abigail is a strong and compassionate leader, traits I’ve seen since we first hit the campaign trail together back in 2018.
She cares deeply about the Virginians she serves — and when she sees a problem, she fixes it.
As a former state Senator and a current Member of Congress, I know that Abigail’s record of public service, her willingness to find common ground, and her lifelong commitment to our Commonwealth and our country make her the right choice to be Virginia’s next Governor. I’m proud to not only endorse her, but I’m also proud to know that Virginia will grow and succeed under her leadership in the coming years.”
Speaker Don Scott
Speaker of the Virginia House of Delegates
“Last year, Virginians made history electing me as the first Black Speaker in our Commonwealth’s history. It’s time to make history again and elect Abigail Spanberger as our first woman Governor. Abigail Spanberger doesn’t wait for others to take the first step — she acts decisively and with purpose. That’s the leadership we need in Richmond as we fight to deliver for everyday Virginians.
As Speaker of the Virginia House of Delegates, I am proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.
In Congress, she has delivered tremendous results for ALL Virginians. From investing in our infrastructure to addressing the addiction crisis in our communities, Congresswoman Spanberger has delivered landmark legislation. That’s why I trust her as Governor to work with the General Assembly to strengthen our public schools, create an economy that works for Virginia’s working families, and protect Virginians’ reproductive freedom. Abigail Spanberger is going to win in November 2025 — and then, together we are going to move Virginia forward.”
Del. Joshua Cole
Virginia House of Delegates, District 65
I am excited to endorse Abigail Spanberger to be our next Governor. Fredericksburg, Spotsylvania, and Stafford have seen Abigail in action — and they know she always delivers.
Abigail always puts the interests of the people above her own interests.
She is a team player, and her example inspires others — including a new generation of leaders — to pursue public service. Abigail is the Democrat we need in Richmond to bring people together, rise above division, and make our communities stronger.”
Del. Irene Shin
Virginia House of Delegates, District 8
Abigail Spanberger has earned my endorsement for Governor of Virginia.
Throughout her career, she has proven herself to be a dedicated public servant and a strong voice for progress.
As our Democratic Governor, I know that Abigail will protect reproductive freedom, expand access to affordable healthcare, and invest in an economy that prioritizes working Virginians. I encourage everyone in the 8th District and across Virginia to join me in supporting Abigail Spanberger for Governor.”
U.S. Rep. Don Beyer (VA-08)
Abigail represents a bold, new generation of Democratic leaders.
As Governor, Abigail will lead with her profound empathy and her contagious optimism. In Congress, I’ve watched Abigail address the most pressing issues of our time. When its passage was in doubt, Abigail pushed the bipartisan infrastructure law over the finish line — and now the people of Virginia are reaping the rewards.
Against all odds, she brought lawmakers of both parties together to pass landmark legislation to address climate change — no easy feat. And she has been on the foremost front lines of protecting our democracy as it remains under attack. I believe that Abigail has not only the experience, but the energy and enthusiasm required to move Virginia forward — and she has my strongest possible endorsement to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.”
Daun Hester
Treasurer, City of Norfolk; former Member of the Virginia House of Delegates, District 89
Today, I am proud to announce my endorsement of Abigail Spanberger to lead Virginia as our next Governor.
In my conversations with Abigail, she has demonstrated a true interest in the lives of Virginians — their hopes, their hardships, and their unique potential. Through her actions, she has demonstrated time and time again her commitment to our communities.
I am confident that Abigail will lift up new voices, keep our communities safe, and make sure every Virginia student — regardless of their background, income bracket, or zip code — has equal access to opportunity. Norfolk, the Tidewater region, and the entire Commonwealth of Virginia will have a fierce champion for our interests and our rights with Abigail leading us forward. I strongly encourage all Democrats to support her candidacy.”
Del. Fernando “Marty” Martinez
Virginia House of Delegates, District 29
Abigail Spanberger has my support and my endorsement to be our next Governor of Virginia.
She has been selfless in her support of her fellow Virginia Democrats, and she understands that we need to work together to rise above division.
I know Abigail to be someone who cares deeply about her family, is devoted to our Commonwealth, and will work with leaders at all levels to get things done. Whether through supporting our fantastic schools, protecting our rights, or making sure we provide Virginia’s veterans with the resources they need, I know that Abigail will be in our corner.”
U.S. Rep. Gerald E. “Gerry” Connolly (VA-11)
I enthusiastically endorse Abigail Spanberger — a true public servant, proud Virginian, and people’s champion — to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.
As her colleague in Congress, I know that Abigail has neither wavered nor delayed in responding to Virginia’s needs. As our Governor, she will create new jobs, lower costs for Virginia families, prioritize our physical infrastructure, and stand with our region’s federal workforce.
And in this moment when our very democracy is under attack, Abigail will defend the dignity and rights of every Virginia citizen. I call on all Democrats in our Commonwealth to place their confidence in our next Governor, Abigail Spanberger.”
Former U.S. Rep. Elaine Luria (VA-02)
Today, I am proud to endorse my friend Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.
Since we first campaigned together during the 2018 cycle, I have seen firsthand her unwavering commitment to public service and her deep love of Virginia.
Our Commonwealth is facing threats to our rights, and our country is facing threats to our democracy. Abigail is no stranger to these tough fights. As Governor, she will be a historic leader for Hampton Roads and the entire Commonwealth — and I am confident that she will strengthen our schools, stand with our veterans, and lower costs for Virginia families.”
Sen. Barbara Favola
Virginia Senate District 40
I enthusiastically endorse Abigail Spanberger for Governor, because I know she will bring common sense, integrity, and a passion for improving the lives of Virginians to the job.
Abigail will be a fierce protector of a woman’s reproductive freedom and will keep the government out of those very personal decisions. I trust her to create the type of future that will enable our children and families to thrive. I hope you can join me in supporting Abigail Spanberger for Governor.”
Michelle Davis-Younger
Mayor of Manassas City
I wholeheartedly endorse Abigail Spanberger as the next Governor of Virginia.
Abigail has not just earned but exemplified a sterling reputation as a leader with an innate understanding of complex challenges.
More importantly, Abigail has and will deliver tangible results for our communities. Without a doubt, she is the right choice to lead our beloved Commonwealth. I urge all Virginia Democrats to rally behind her campaign and embrace her message of optimism over division.”
Former U.S. Rep. Rick Boucher (VA-09)
Abigail Spanberger has represented Virginia honorably and with courage in Congress.
She has earned my endorsement to serve as our next Governor of Virginia. I can think of no other Democrat who is more prepared for guiding our state into a new era of prosperity. I represented Southwest Virginia during many difficult times and during moments of great change, and Abigail is no stranger to these challenges.
She will lead our communities — including our rural areas — with her competence, her steady and thoughtful leadership, and her commitment to making the lives of all Virginians better, and I know that as Governor she will be responsive to the needs of Southwest Virginians.
Sen. Adam Ebbin
Virginia Senate District 39
I am honored to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as our next Governor. Abigail has proven she can bring people together to get results for Virginia.
That’s why I’m proud to join the hundreds of thousands of Virginians, from Richmond to Northern Virginia, who have already entrusted her with their votes.
And as Governor, we can count on Abigail to keep delivering results for us. I am eager to partner with her on issues important to Alexandria, Arlington, and Fairfax — ranging from preventing gun violence and protecting access to reproductive health care to delivering on the promise of equality for all Virginians.”
Sen. Schuyler VanValkenburg
Virginia Senate, District 16
Abigail works hard, has a deep love of Virginia, and has always put public service above herself — and that’s why I am very proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.
As a public school teacher, I know that Abigail will always prioritize strong investments in our schools.
As a parent, I know that she will focus on keeping Virginia kids safe from gun violence. And in the State Senate, I look forward to working with future Governor Spanberger to lower costs for families, protect the fundamental freedoms of all Virginians, and bring people together in a bipartisan way to strengthen our communities.”
Frank Reaves, Jr.
Mayor of Culpeper
As our Representative in Congress, Abigail Spanberger has always delivered for Culpeper.
When the Carver Center needed a new roof, she got funding. When RRCS needed more space to treat those grappling with addiction, she got it done. And when volunteer EMTs in our community needed a new ambulance, she came through.
Abigail even brought the President of the United States to Culpeper to hear directly from Virginians about the need to lower drug prices. That is the definition of representation, and it’s why I’m proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.”
Del. Elizabeth Bennett-Parker
Virginia House of Delegates, District 5
I am proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as Virginia’s next Governor.
As a mom, I’m grateful for Abigail’s track record of getting things done on issues all Virginia families care about most — lowering drug prices, tackling hunger among Virginia’s kids, expanding access to affordable childcare, and defending our reproductive rights. I look forward to working directly with Abigail to deliver for Virginia’s families.”
Former Del. Sally Hudson
Virginia House of Delegates, District 57
Abigail has earned a reputation for showing up everywhere and building broad coalitions to take on big problems.
That’s leadership. I’m proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger for Governor.
In Congress, Abigail is a proven leader in creating jobs, investing in broadband, and protecting our planet for future generations. As Governor, I know she will defend abortion access, strengthen our public schools, and expand economic opportunities in all corners of our Commonwealth.”
Del. Rodney Willett
Virginia House of Delegates, District 58
Abigail Spanberger has my strong endorsement to serve as Virginia’s next Governor.
Henrico residents know and trust Abigail. She has always been ready to lend a hand to her fellow Virginians, she has demonstrated a commitment to solving problems, and she knows how to get things done.
Under Abigail’s leadership, the Commonwealth will see progress on the issues that impact all who call Virginia home — from lowering drug costs to growing our economy to making sure our schools are the best in the country.”
Mary Katherine Greenlaw
Former Mayor of Fredericksburg
I am proud to support Abigail Spanberger to serve as our next Governor of Virginia.
Fredericksburg residents know that when we call, Abigail will answer. In Congress, she has prioritized working with leaders at all levels — federal, state, and local — to make sure Virginia gets results. That is the kind of leadership we need in our next Governor, and I know the Fredericksburg community will greatly benefit from Abigail leading us forward.”
Former U.S. Rep. Tom Perriello (VA-05)
I’m fired up that we Virginians will have a chance to elect Abigail Spanberger as our next Governor!
Abigail is a leader whose service record demonstrates her willingness to do what is difficult to put her community, Commonwealth, and country first.
She’s taken on the special interests to deliver cheaper prescription drugs, expanded broadband access, and made investments in green jobs. She’s been a bulwark for our fundamental freedoms while also building bridges to fight political corruption and attacks on our democracy. I proudly endorse Abigail to serve as our next Governor of Virginia.”
Former Del. Kathleen Murphy
Virginia House of Delegates, District 34
Today, I am excited to endorse Abigail Spanberger — a leader with integrity and vision — to serve as our next Governor.
Abigail has always worked to bring Virginians together to tackle our most important issues, including preventing gun violence, making healthcare more accessible and affordable, and investing in our students and our schools.
I am confident that Abigail is the right choice to lead our Commonwealth and deliver results for Virginia’s families, economy, and next generation.”
Former Del. Mark Keam

I have no doubt that, as Governor, Abigail will continue her hard work on the issues that matter most to our Loudoun communities — preventing gun violence, lowering costs for working parents, and protecting our reproductive rights. As a former school board member and educator, I know that Abigail will put our students, teachers, and families first to make sure we have a world-class public education system.”
Del. Debra Gardner
Virginia House of Delegates, District 76
Abigail Spanberger has always been a force for progress, a voice for all Virginians, and a tireless champion for Virginia’s working families.
I’m proud to endorse her to serve as our next Governor — because she is the leader we need to invest in education, lower costs, protect our rights, and bring more economic stability to all Virginians. She has my strongest support, and I look forward to working with Abigail to get things done for Chesterfield County and the entire Commonwealth.”
Former Del. Mike Mullin
Virginia House of Delegates, District 93
Abigail Spanberger has always championed the idea of public service — putting others first and working together to get things done for Virginia.
Based on my many conversations with Abigail, I know that Hampton Roads and the entire Commonwealth will be stronger under her leadership. That’s why I am proud to endorse Abigail — a Virginian who will prioritize our schools, our safety, and an economy that provides opportunity to everyone — to serve as Virginia’s next Governor.”
Viola O. Baskerville
Former Virginia Secretary of Administration & Former Member, Virginia House of Delegates
Abigail Spanberger is an experienced public servant who does everything possible to deliver results for Virginia — including for our communities of color.
In Congress, she has been vocal about addressing Virginia’s high maternal mortality rate, particularly among Black women. Additionally, she has always voted to protect the right to vote — including through her support for the
John Lewis Voting Rights Act
. And as the only Virginian on the House Agriculture Committee, Abigail has championed increased funding for Virginia’s HBCUs — which have been underfunded for far too long. Her commitment to the health, education, and fundamental rights of our communities is why I am proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as Virginia’s next Governor.”
Ward Armstrong
Former Minority Leader, Virginia House of Delegates
Abigail Spanberger knows how to get things done — and she has experience in bringing people together, finding common ground, and delivering wins for our Commonwealth.
Southwest Virginia needs a Governor who pays attention to our schools, our physical infrastructure, and the job opportunities available to our young people — and I believe that Abigail is the right choice to address the challenges facing our communities. I’m proud to endorse her to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.”
Takis Karantonis
Vice Chair, Arlington County Board
Abigail Spanberger is a true leader who has demonstrated her commitment to addressing the issues that matter most to Virginia’s families and Virginia’s economy.
As challenges and opportunities arise in Arlington and in Northern Virginia, we need a Governor who will be laser-focused on making sure that our Commonwealth works to the benefit of all our residents. Abigail Spanberger is a trusted problem-solver who brings to the table real solutions that tackle long standing challenges, from the environment, to housing, to our schools, to transportation and infrastructure, to overcoming the legacy of the many inequalities in Virginia and shaping a bright and fair future for all. I am more than honored to endorse Abigail to serve as our 75th Governor of Virginia.”
Jeff McKay
Chairman, Fairfax County Board of Supervisors
As a lifelong Fairfax County resident, I know that our communities deserve a Governor who works with local leaders to lower costs, address emerging infrastructure needs, and fully invest in public education.
Abigail Spanberger is a true champion for the people of Virginia, and she will be a tremendously effective Governor when it comes to getting things done for Fairfax County. That’s why I am proud to endorse her to serve as Virginia’s next Governor — because she understands the enormous opportunities the Commonwealth has ahead of it right now. She will prioritize strong schools, economic growth that expands the middle class, and a government in Richmond that restores a fundamental sense of public service.”
Jimmy Bierman
Abigail Spanberger will work relentlessly to push our Commonwealth to reach its potential every single day.
As a public servant, Abigail has always made clear her focus on expanding opportunity for everyone in our communities — from working families to small businesses to our students in the classroom. She has the unique ability to find common ground while never sacrificing her principles, and I’m proud to endorse her to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.”
James Walkinshaw
As a Virginian who has devoted my career to making sure our community is a great place to live and raise a family, I am proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger for Governor.
I look forward to working with Abigail to keep our residents safe, bring more high-paying jobs to our region, and create more opportunities for our workforce and students. Abigail’s sense of public service will not only bring people together, but it will usher in a new era of thoughtful leadership across our Commonwealth.”
Juli E. Briskman
Vice Chair, Loudoun County Board of Supervisors
Abigail Spanberger listens to the Virginians she serves, works tirelessly, and delivers results.
To address the many challenges our Commonwealth faces, we need her energy and her ability to bring people together. I know Abigail will work hard for our shared values, to protect reproductive freedom, fully fund our schools, support our first responders, and invest in critical infrastructure. Today, I’m proud and excited to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the 75th Governor of Virginia.”
Michael Sutphin
Vice Mayor, Blacksburg
Abigail Spanberger knows how to work with all levels of government — local, state, and federal alike — to move Virginia forward.
That’s why I’m proud to endorse her to serve as our next Governor. Abigail will focus on bringing new jobs to our region, investing in our physical infrastructure, creating more economic opportunity for Blacksburg families, and responding to the needs of our community’s students. I look forward to working with her to get things done for Blacksburg and all of our Commonwealth!”
Treney Tweedy
Former Mayor, Lynchburg
Abigail Spanberger will bring her relentless work ethic, dedication, and sense of public service to the job of Governor of Virginia — and I’m proud to offer my strong endorsement.
As a former mayor, I know what it takes to get things done — and I’m confident that Abigail will help Virginians reach new opportunities. As Governor, she will focus on increasing public safety in our neighborhoods, strengthening the schools in our communities, and bringing more economic opportunities to all Virginians and their families. That’s the commitment to the people of Virginia that we need going forward.”
Luke Priddy
Roanoke City Council
I’m proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.
Her integrity, demonstrated record of results, and passion for public service are exactly what Virginia needs in the chief executive of the Commonwealth. As Governor, I’m confident she will take action to protect the rights of all Virginians, invest in our schools and teachers, and create safer communities for the people of Roanoke and the entire Commonwealth.”
Susan Anderson
Blacksburg Town Council
Abigail Spanberger is an energetic public servant who has never backed down from putting Virginians first, and I am honored to endorse Abigail to serve as our next Governor.
She will protect our reproductive freedoms, defend voting rights, and make sure Virginia is a welcoming place for all to call home. Her commitment to supporting our public schools and investing in our teachers shows that she truly cares about building a Virginia that can grow and succeed for generations to come. Abigail will deliver for the people of Blacksburg, and she has my strongest support.”
Maya Guy
Vice Chair, Stafford County School Board
Stafford County families deserve a Governor who will work every single day to make sure our students are supported, safe, and set up for success.
That’s why I am proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger, because I’ve seen her work ethic and determination firsthand. As Governor, Abigail will help Virginia’s school districts recruit and retain teachers and staff — and she will make sure our public schools receive the full funding they deserve to give our kids every shot at opportunity.”
Jenefer Hughes
Commissioner of the Revenue, Chesterfield County
Abigail Spanberger has always led a top-notch team that focuses on responsibly serving Virginians — and she has my endorsement to serve as the next Governor of our beautiful Commonwealth.
In Congress, she has demonstrated extraordinary integrity and leadership while representing her constituents in the Seventh District. I know that she will bring this same commitment to people and public service as our next Governor. She is the right choice for Chesterfield’s taxpayers, businesses, and future.”
Sen. Scott Surovell
Senate Majority Leader, Virginia Senate
Abigail Spanberger is the decisive public servant Virginia needs, and I’m proud to endorse her to serve as our 75th Governor.
Under her leadership, the Commonwealth will have a Governor who actually works with our Democratic majority to get things done for the Virginians we serve. She will prioritize progress over the endless campaigning and partisanship that we see out of the Governor’s Mansion today. Abigail will join with General Assembly Democrats to focus on priorities that unite Virginians like closing the multi-billion dollar funding gap in public K-12 and higher education, protecting reproductive rights, preventing gun violence, and making Virginia more affordable for working families. With Abigail as Governor, I’m confident that we will see a stronger and safer Virginia.
Dick Saslaw
Former Senate Majority Leader, Virginia Senate
Abigail Spanberger gets things done, and I’m proud to endorse her.
She has never wavered in fighting for her principles, listening to the concerns of Virginians, and bringing both parties together to do what is best for the Commonwealth. That’s the leadership we need serving the people of Virginia in Richmond. Her focus on schools, safety, and more economic opportunity for all Virginians will make sure we are the best place in the country to live, work, and raise a family.”
Sen. Lashrecse Aird
Virginia Senate, District 13
Before any elected title, I’m a working mom, and I know firsthand the real challenges facing Virginia’s families.
I join them in believing our next Governor must deliver real results for our communities — and the only leader to trust with this goal in mind is Abigail Spanberger. So much feels out of reach for Virginians, whether it’s access to a livable wage, owning a home, living in a safe community, and, particularly, affording quality healthcare. Abigail Spanberger has been in the trenches for Virginians, and her passion and determination reflect a record of putting people first. I’m proud to endorse Abigail to serve as our next Governor, because, during unprecedented times such as these, I know she has a vision that will uplift all of our communities and lessen the burdens felt by working families.”
Sen. Jeremy McPike
Virginia Senate, District 29
Abigail truly connects with people, and she understands the challenges Virginians face every single day.
In Congress, she has focused on investing in our infrastructure, lowering drug costs, and providing more mental health services to the Virginians who need them. I’ve seen her drive, devotion to public service, and empathy firsthand. As our next Governor, Abigail will deliver results for our schools, for the safety of our communities, and for our economy. I’m proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as Virginia’s next Governor.”
Brian Moran
Former Virginia Secretary of Public Safety & Homeland Security; Former Member, Virginia House of Delegates
As a Virginian who served in the cabinets of our two previous Democratic Governors, I am proud to announce my endorsement of Abigail Spanberger to serve as our Commonwealth’s next Governor.
She has the experience, the determination, and the deep sense of public service required to effectively get things done for Virginia. Abigail Spanberger will always put the safety, security, and prosperity of Virginia families first.”
Del. Patrick Hope
Virginia House of Delegates, District 1
Virginia needs a Governor who will address our longstanding transportation issues, pay our teachers what they deserve, lower costs for working families, and protect the rights of all Virginians.
I’m confident that Abigail Spanberger is the right leader at the right moment to deliver on these critical priorities. After November 2025, I’m looking forward to working with her in Richmond to respond to the needs of the Virginians I serve.”
Del. David Bulova
Virginia House of Delegates, District 11
Abigail Spanberger knows how to bring people together, and she has a record of getting things done.
She inspires Virginians to rise above division and do the right thing for the Commonwealth we all call home. I am especially grateful for her strong, bipartisan leadership to restore the Chesapeake Bay and to make Virginia more resilient to the impacts of climate change. That’s the kind of leadership and vision we need in our next Governor.”
Del. Holly Seibold
Virginia House of Delegates, District 12
Abigail is dedicated to strengthening our schools, supporting our small businesses, defending our reproductive rights, and keeping our kids safe — and that’s the leadership we need in our next Governor.
As a fellow mom, I know that Abigail Spanberger understands the importance of investing in our public schools. And as a former public school teacher, I am ready to serve with a Governor who understands the tremendous value and hard work our educators bring to the classroom every single day. As Governor, Abigail will get things done for Northern Virginia and the entire Commonwealth — and I’m proud to endorse her.”
Del. Vivian Watts
Virginia House of Delegates, District 14
Virginia needs a Governor who will stand up for families, work together with Democrats in the General Assembly, and protect the rights of all Virginians.
I know that Abigail Spanberger will not only deliver results for our Commonwealth, but is committed to moving Virginia’s economy, schools, and communities forward. That’s why I’m proud to endorse her to serve as our 75th Governor.”
Del. Kannan Srinivasan
Virginia House of Delegates, District 26
As Governor, Abigail will protect the gains that Democrats have made for the people of Virginia.
She has my strong endorsement, because she will be a Governor who works with the General Assembly to lower healthcare costs for families, protect abortion rights, and create more economic opportunities for Loudoun County and all of Virginia. And as the proud son of school teachers, I know that Abigail shares my core belief in the value and importance of public education.”
Del. Nadarius Clark,
Virginia House of Delegates, District 84
Abigail Spanberger leads with actions, not just words.
Her track record in Congress and her career of public service demonstrate that she cares about getting results. She has always been a champion for gun violence prevention, a defender of our fundamental rights, and someone who knows that the success of our public schools determines the success of our Commonwealth. I’m ready to work with Abigail to get things done for our youth and for Hampton Roads, and I can’t wait to serve with a Governor who truly puts the people first.”
Del. Phil Hernandez
Virginia House of Delegates,  District 94
I’m supporting Abigail Spanberger for Governor, because I know she’ll champion policies that protect reproductive freedom, strengthen our democracy, support public education, and help everyday families succeed.
Virginia stands at a crossroads — and Abigail is the right leader at the right time.”
Del. Alex Askew
Virginia House of Delegates, District 95
Abigail Spanberger is a proven leader who truly cares about the future of our Commonwealth — whether it’s Virginia Beach, Norfolk, or anywhere else in Virginia.
In recent years, we’ve made tremendous progress for Virginians, but we need a Governor who is committed to protecting that progress and moving us forward. As Governor, Abigail will defend our fundamental freedoms. She will grow our economy in a way that improves the lives of working families across Hampton Roads. And she will stand up to attacks on our public schools. That’s why I’m endorsing Abigail for Governor.”
Del. Michael Feggans
Virginia House of Delegates, District 97
Abigail has always lived a life of public service — whether in service to her community, her Commonwealth, or her country.
I strongly endorse her to serve as Virginia’s next Governor. As a veteran, I know that Abigail will always have the backs of our active-duty servicemembers, our veterans, and our military families. And as a legislator, I know that we will have a reliable partner in the Governor’s Mansion who will defend women’s rights, expand the middle class, and invest in our public schools and our teachers. She is a true leader.”
Tyrone E. Nelson
Chair, Henrico County Board of Supervisors
For several years, Henrico County saw firsthand how Abigail Spanberger responded to the needs of our community with energy and vigor.
She brought the voices of our neighbors to the decision-making table, and she delivered tangible results — from investments in infrastructure to more resources to prevent addiction. That’s why I know that Abigail will be an effective Governor who will prioritize policies that make a difference in the daily lives of Virginians.”
Walter Alcorn
Abigail Spanberger knows what Virginia and Virginians need, which is why I’m proud to endorse her to serve as our next Governor.
Here in Fairfax County, we need a Governor who cares about supporting our schools, increasing funding for mental health services, and creating more affordable housing for our residents. I am confident that Abigail will be a Governor who delivers real progress on these priorities for our entire Commonwealth.”
Rodney L. Lusk
As a former county employee and current Member of the Fairfax County Board of Supervisors, I know what it takes to keep our government running and make sure it’s serving the best interests of the people.
I know that Abigail Spanberger understands what it means to be effective, as well. As our next Governor, she will work to address affordable housing challenges, workforce development needs, and ongoing challenges related to public safety and gun violence. Abigail has my endorsement and my support to serve as the next chief executive of the Commonwealth.”
Mary W. Biggs
Abigail Spanberger has built a reputation for working with federal, state, and local officials to find common ground and deliver results on our shared priorities.
I’m honored to endorse Abigail to serve as Virginia’s next Governor, because I know that she cares about the future of our economy, our schools, our students, and our families. She is the right choice with the right experience to serve us as the future Governor of our Commonwealth.”
April N. DeMotts
Abigail Spanberger has a vision for a stronger Virginia with more opportunity for Virginia families, and that’s why I’m proud to support her to serve as our next Governor.
Here in Montgomery County, we benefit best from a strong working relationship with our state officials. As our partner in Richmond, Abigail Spanberger will prioritize our infrastructure and natural resources, our schools, and the safety of our community.”
Derek Kitts
Abigail Spanberger is the leader Virginia needs to address the many challenges facing our county, our region, and our Commonwealth.
She understands what it means to serve her community and her country. Abigail is pragmatic, always focusing on practical solutions that benefit the people she serves. It’s never about her. That’s the type of leadership and focus we need in our next Governor to move Virginia forward, and I’m honored to endorse her.”
Alonzo Jones
Mayor, Danville
Abigail Spanberger is already putting in the hard work to get to know our communities and learn more about Danville’s priorities.
She knows that an effective Governor takes into account the perspectives of all corners of Virginia — and then gets to work on day one. Once she’s elected, I know she will prioritize working with both parties to support our schools, keep our community members safe, and increase economic opportunities for our residents. I am proud to endorse her to serve as the next Governor of Virginia.”
Neal Osborne
Former Mayor, Bristol
Communities like Bristol need a Governor in Richmond who will not only hear our concerns, listen to our needs, and make promises, but will also follow through on them.
I’m happy to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as the next Governor of Virginia, because she has a demonstrated record of delivering for all of her constituents and responding to the unique challenges facing Virginia’s smaller communities and rural areas. Abigail will work directly with local officials to find solutions that work for Southwest Virginia’s challenges — from growing our economy to keeping our public schools strong.”
Chuck Frye Jr.
Vice Mayor, Fredericksburg
Abigail Spanberger is a leader who listens to the people, and that’s why she understands the challenges that Virginia families and Virginia workers are facing on a daily basis.
She doesn’t just claim to support the labor community — she proves it every day through her work in Congress. As our next Governor, Abigail will have our backs. As a Teamsters Union member for more than 20 years, I’m proud to endorse a true champion of Fredericksburg’s economy and the workers that power it.”
Joe Cobb
Vice Mayor, Roanoke
I’ve had the opportunity to get to know Abigail and to share Roanoke’s perspective on the issues facing our community.
She gets it. She knows that these times require Virginians to work together, at all levels of government, to address our shared challenges. As Governor, Abigail will focus on strong schools, reliable transportation infrastructure, and community safety. That’s why I’m honored to endorse her to serve as Virginia’s next Governor.”
Billy M. Bates
Fairfax City Council
“I’m excited and proud to announce my endorsement of Congresswoman Abigail Spanberger to serve as our next Governor. In Congress, she has demonstrated a clear commitment to the Virginians she serves — and as Governor, she will do the same. She is the right choice for the City of Fairfax’s students, families, and small businesses at a time when we need steady leadership, not division and vitriol, more than ever before.”
Madison Irving
Henrico County School Board
Henrico County residents know very well that Abigail Spanberger is relentlessly focused on listening to Virginians, addressing their challenges, and getting things done.
That’s a reputation she has earned through hard work. When it comes to supporting our schools, I am confident that Abigail will be a reliable partner who’ll always strive to do what is best for our students, parents, and community members. I’m proud to endorse Abigail Spanberger to serve as our next Governor.”

Editorial: Don Bacon has approached his work responsibly; he deserves a second term
In a recent interview, U.S. Rep. Don Bacon was asked about immigration issues. Bacon, a retired Air Force brigadier general who’s completing a first term in Congress, answered with a balanced viewpoint.
He described how he’s voted for proposals that give each side something in order for the country to move forward on the issue. Specifically, he’s supported legislation that would bolster border security while also providing a legal path forward for DACA residents.
Then he emphasized, “We’re going to have to compromise if we’re going to get anything done.”
That’s exactly right. It’s the needed message and tone not just for immigration but also for many other complicated issues. This is a central reason why we’re recommending Bacon in this year’s 2nd District election. In the contest between Bacon and Democratic nominee Kara Eastman, we find Bacon to be more open to the type of pragmatic approaches we often find appropriate at the state and national levels.
This focus on pragmatism has been the guidepost in our endorsements for the past several 2nd District elections.
On the health care issue, for example, Bacon told us, “I support incremental change.” We find that tack more appropriate than the call, supported by Eastman, for national health care restructuring on a massive level — an approach we find fraught with wide-ranging uncertainties and complications in attempting to shift away from the current system. Changes made should be achievable and prudent.
Another indicator of Bacon’s pragmatism is his current membership on the national Bipartisan Climate Solutions Caucus. At a candidate debate, he pointed to his work to maintain federal tax credits for investments in wind and solar energy as part of the federal tax reform effort. He also noted his co-sponsorship of a law that steers research dollars into expanded battery storage, a key component of expanding the use of renewable energy sources.
A World-Herald news article on Bacon included an observation from Rep. Salud Carbajal, D-Calif., about how he and Bacon, a Republican, have worked across party lines on legislation involving issues from immigration to national defense.
“I’m pro-choice, he’s pro-life. There’s a number of issues where we differ significantly,” Carbajal said. “He’s open to listening, and I think that’s important if we’re going to build a relationship and try to find common ground.”
It’s encouraging, too, that Bacon consistently employs a civil tone in his comments. That’s a welcome contrast from the heated rhetoric and pettiness that too often characterize current political debate in Washington.
The 2nd District is politically “purple,” and we realize a considerable portion of the 2nd District will see things differently in sizing up these two candidates. We realize, too, that this is an era of intense ideological polarization, with many in the Republican and Democratic Parties racing away from the political center and in many cases embracing “my way or the highway” thinking. We don’t regard that as healthy for our country and its policy deliberations. Bacon is a conventional Republican in an era of often furious political warring, but his measured tone and openness to flexibility in some instances are pluses.
We note Eastman’s capabilities and past public service. She has served conscientiously, for example, on the Metropolitan Community College board, an office for which we’ve endorsed her in past elections. Our central disagreement involves the scale of government expansion, and the associated uncertainties and costs, that would flow from her general approach.
As for Bacon, it’s fitting that this retired 55th Wing commander at Offutt Air Force Base would direct much of his legislative work toward national security issues. He’s shown commendable energy and strong analytical ability in that regard as a member of the House Armed Services Committee.
He has twice been tapped to be in the group responsible for reconciling differences between the House and Senate versions of the annual defense policy bill — an unusual honor for a freshman. He has given appropriate priority to veterans issues.
Because of his prudence and acknowledgement that constructive compromise is needed on complex, divisive issues, we find that U.S. Rep.
is deserving of a second term representing the 2nd Congressional District.

New Mexico Fraternal Order of Police
“Tom Udall has spent his career serving the citizens of New Mexico. He has a proven record of supporting laws that protect our citizens and he has always been a strong supporter of law enforcement. The New Mexico Fraternal Order of Police, building on a proud tradition, is honored to endorse Tom Udall for Senate.”
Bill Standridge, NM FOP State President
June 23, 2008
Veterans’ Vision
“The Veterans’ Vision has consistently endorsed Representative Udall since he was elected to serve the New Mexico 3rd district in 1998. Representative Udall, whose family has a long record of public service, has earned a reputation of working hard for veterans.”
June 5, 2008
National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare (NCPSSM)
“Our nation needs your leadership, vision and determination to fight for working families and older Americans. You understand that congressional efforts to privatize Social Security, which would undermine the most successful social insurance program ever, continue. You recognize fully that the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act pulls the plug on Medicare’s universal risk pool and sets the stage for efforts to unravel Medicare through privatization. National Committee members and supporters want you in the United States Senate to continue protecting Social Security and Medicare—the twin pillars necessary to a good quality of life for Americans of all ages.”
Barbara B. Kennelly, President and CEO, NCPSSM
July 2, 2008
Hispano Round Table
(April 16, 2008)
New Mexico Fire Fighters Association (Endorsed in the Democratic Primary)
AFL-CIO (December 2007)
Association of Federal State County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME)
“Tom is a once-in-a-lifetime elected official. He is the type of person that we never have to second guess where he stands on workers issues. He has always been with labor and we are very thankful for that.”
December 19, 2007
Council for a Livable World
“The Board of Directors of Council for a Livable World Candidate Fund has voted to endorse your candidacy for the United States Senate because of your commitment to nuclear arms control and curbs on the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction.”
December 13, 2007
New Mexico Building and Construction Trades Council
“For your support and leadership in the community, and your work in the U.S. Congress, the New Mexico Building and Construction Trades Council is proud and honored to endorse your candidacy in the upcoming general election for the United States Senate. We know you will serve the people of New Mexico well as our Senator in Washington.”
Ray M. Baca, Executive Director, NMBCTC
June 19, 2008
League of Conservation Voters and Conservation Voters of New Mexico
“Here in New Mexico, CVNM (Conservation Voters New Mexico) applauds Rep. Tom Udall (D-3rd) for a perfect score of 100 percent and for his leadership on the energy bill. (Rep. Udall introduced an amendment that would have required utilities to produce at least 15 percent of their electricity from renewable energy sources by 2020.) Rep. Udall's legislation would have saved consumers billions of dollars on their energy bills and created many new green collar jobs here in New Mexico while dramatically slashing global warming pollution. Unfortunately, a minority of senators eventually stripped that important provision from the bill.”
Sandy Buffett, Executive Director, CVNM
February 21, 2008
Defenders of Wildlife
“New Mexico presents a rare opportunity for Americans who care about conservation to increase their ranks in the Senate and House. Representative Tom Udall has a stellar conservation record and we know he’d be a true champion for New Mexico in the Senate. Conversely, Representatives Steve Pearce and Heather Wilson both have atrocious conservation records. They both sit on House committees that are vital to our nation’s conservation efforts, yet both have voted repeatedly to provide tax breaks to polluting industries and undermine key laws that protect our air, land and water.”
Rodger Schlickeisen, President, Action Fund
February 22, 2008
IATSE Local 480
“We feel that your Congressional record and political viewpoints are intrinsically in sync with the ideologies held by the majority of our members and we would welcome your presence in the US Senate.”
Laurie L. Hudson, Secretary Treasurer
January 25, 2008
Planned Parenthood
(March 10, 2008)
International Association of Bridge Structural, Ornamental and Reinforcing Iron Workers, Local No. 495
(January 14, 2008)
“The Ironworkers Local Union 495 is proud and honored to announce that, for all of your accomplishments, your strong leadership locally and nationally, your democracy, your representation of this country as US House of Representatives, Your Will to be a strong Advocate for New Mexico, Your support for labor and many more reasons, its membership voted unanimously at its regular membership meeting on January 11, 2008 to endorse you in your candidacy for United States Senate.”
Jerry Romero, Business Manager/FS-T, IABSORIW Local No. 495
January 14, 2008
American Federation of Teachers (AFT)
NEA – National Education Association
“The National Education Association – New Mexico – which recommended your Candidacy – and the NEA Fund applaud your commitment to public education and children.”
Reg Weaver, Chairperson, The NEA Chairperson

“Our New Mexico CWA Locals want to thank you for your energy and commitment to working families in New Mexico. We wholeheartedly thank you for your firm support of Employee Free Choice Act and your ongoing efforts to do what is right and who has the integrity and experience we can trust to supporting working families in New Mexico”
Phillip Sweeney, President, New Mexico CWA State Council
