“Jimmy Gomez stands up for those who do not have a voice. He knows how much immigrants contribute to our nation, and how hard they work to provide for their families. We can trust Jimmy Gomez, he has the honesty and integrity we need in our representatives. I proudly endorse Jimmy Gomez for Congress.”
Dolores Huerta |
Civil Rights Leader
"In Congress, it's important to have dedicated and committed allies who can deliver on our progressive agenda. Congressman Jimmy Gomez and I worked together to secure federal funds to restore the LA River and combat climate change, help Californians stay housed during pandemic, and increase citizenship education to help the next generation of immigrants become U.S. citizens. Jimmy is a proven progressive who delivers for us everyday. I am excited to stand with him in his re-election campaign."
Alex Padilla |
U.S. Senator
“I’m grateful to have had Jimmy as a partner in Congress over the past three-plus years. From our work together on the House Oversight and Reform Committee to advocating for the rights of immigrants, standing up for workers, and fighting for healthcare justice, Jimmy works incredibly hard for the people of the California 34th, and all of our communities. I’m proud to endorse him for re-election, and look forward to continuing to work alongside him in Congress.”
Ayanna Pressley |
Congresswoman, MA-7
"Jimmy Gomez is the one I trust to take the fight to Washington and continue moving the ball forward for our communities and the progressive movement. There are few elected officials who are as effective and principled as Jimmy. He’s the one I know will fight for us –and win – in Congress.”
Sandra Figueroa-Villa |
Executive Director of El Centro Del Pueblo
“As the first Korean American Democrat to be elected to Congress, I have always deeply respected Jimmy as he holds the unique privilege of representing the congressional district with the largest Korean American community in Congress. From COVID-19 relief to supporting small businesses, and protecting tenants, Jimmy has been delivering results for Korean Americans and the rest of his district for years, and I am proud to support his re-election campaign”
Andy Kim |
Congressman, NJ-3
“My colleague Jimmy Gomez fights for working people and those most in need. We worked side-by-side to pass the Build Back Better Act, which would be the most transformative investment in children and caregiving in generations, and the largest effort to combat climate change – and we won’t give up. And Jimmy Gomez is a co-sponsor of Medicare For All, because it is the most effective way to expand healthcare and reduce costs for everybody. We need Jimmy in Congress.”
Pramila Jayapal |
U.S. Representative and Progressive Caucus Chair
"Jimmy Gomez is an outstanding representative for the people I previously served in Congress. We have worked closely together since he became our Assemblyman. President Obama cited his Paid Family Leave bill as a national model.  He's been at the forefront against climate change and domestic violence, to increase the minimum wage and to make higher education affordable. We need a champion like Jimmy Gomez."
Xavier Becerra |
Secretary of the Department of Health and Human Services
“Jimmy is a fighter, and someone we can count on to not back down. He’ll go to Washington to stand up to Trump and the Republicans. His record of standing up to corporations, unfair employers, and for the rights of all Californians, and winning, makes him the best choice to represent us in Congress.”
Kevin de Leon |
Councilmember, CD-14
“I trust Jimmy Gomez to fight to protect Obamacare and preserve vital health care funding for our families.”
Hilda Solis |
LA County Supervisor
“We need leaders like Jimmy Gomez who will stand up and fight for our beliefs and move our country forward with innovative, progressive ideas. Jimmy has done just that in the State Assembly, leading landmark expansions of Paid Family Leave, funding domestic violence prevention, and expanding access and funding for higher education.”
Eric Garcetti |
Mayor of Los Angeles

“People need to know their elected officials are fighting for their reproductive rights, especially during public health crises like we’re experiencing now. Planned Parenthood Action Fund is proud to endorse Stephanie Schmid for Congress in New Jersey’s 4th District. With her background as a human rights attorney and reproductive rights advocate, we know she will work tirelessly to ensure everyone can access the care they need — no matter what.”
– Planned Parenthood Action Fund President, Alexis McGill Johnson
“I am excited that Planned Parenthood Action Fund is endorsing Stephanie Schmid for Congress in NJ-04. Stephanie is a dedicated advocate who has critical experience writing legislation to protect our reproductive health care, and we would be lucky to have her fighting as part of our New Jersey Delegation in favor of full reproductive rights for all.”
– Kaitlyn Wojtowicz, Vice President of Public Affairs, Planned Parenthood Action Fund of New Jersey
“Stephanie has served our country with distinction, and it’s that same commitment to service that drives her campaign today to represent her community. As a former U.S. diplomat and an advocate for women’s reproductive rights, Stephanie has demonstrated repeatedly her commitment to defending our rights and freedoms. She brings the empathy and seriousness we need from our Congressional leaders — rooted in facts, committed to service, and with zero time for BS. That’s why we’re so proud to endorse her.”
Andrew Albertson, Executive Director of Foreign Policy for America
“Stephanie Schmid has a long record of elevating the voices of the marginalized and fighting for those who can’t fight for themselves. From her work across the globe with the State Department to her time directing foreign policy at the Center for Reproductive Rights, Stephanie has always put others before herself. I’m proud to endorse her.”
– Rep. Seth Moulton (MA-6), Founder of Serve America
“The district needs new leadership, and that is why BlueWaveNJ enthusiastically endorses Stephanie Schmid. Candidate Schmid holds an impressive resume as a foreign service officer and diplomat for the U.S. Department of State and as a human rights attorney and advocate. In-office, Schmid will focus on securing affordable healthcare for every American, protecting women’s reproductive rights, combating climate change, passing gun safety reforms, and ensuring every child has access to pre-K and early learning programs. Her record of service and the contrast of her priorities from her opponents shows an individual who will be an advocate for BlueWaveNJ’s goals. She faces a tight race, but Schmid is a strong candidate that represents the best chance to flip the 4th Congressional District blue.”
– BlueWaveNJ
2020 Moms Demand Action Candidate Distinction
Moms Demand Action is part of Everytown for Gun Safety, and is the nation’s largest grassroots volunteer network working to end gun violence in America. This distinction is awarded to candidates who are committed to advocating for gun violence prevention and governing with gun safety in mind.
Elect Democratic Women
Stephanie is supported by Elect Democratic Women, an organization focused on electing more Democratic women to Congress.
“Stephanie’s service to our country as a retired U.S. Foreign Service Officer and her dedication to lifting up communities prove that she is the type of leader we need in Washington and in New Jersey. I look forward to having a colleague in NJ-04 to work with on critical climate change legislation, as Stephanie and I are both deeply committed to protecting our environment and our beloved Jersey Shore. I know I can count on her to join the rest of New Jersey’s Democratic delegation in the fight to repeal the State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction cap, and she will work tirelessly to ensure that every American has access to affordable healthcare. I am proud to support Stephanie.”
– Congressman Frank Pallone, NJ-06
“Stephanie has the background and expertise as a retired Foreign Service Officer, U.S. Diplomat and human rights attorney to finally flip this seat and represent our district. For years we’ve watched Chris Smith attack women’s healthcare in our name, and that needs to end now. I had the pleasure of getting to know Stephanie personally as she volunteered and worked hard for not only my race but so many of our local races. I look forward to having a partner at the federal level to work for our community and what truly matters to our constituents.”
– Assemblywoman Joann Downey, LD-11
“Stephanie has worked tirelessly to meet with folks throughout Monmouth County, listening to their needs and ensuring our community that she is a present and responsive leader who will work on behalf of all of us in Washington. I was impressed to see Stephanie and her campaign volunteer their time to help our local candidates running for election last fall, and I continue to be impressed with her dedication to this race and to our community during this crisis. We share a commitment to helping elect democrats running up and down the ballot. I look forward to working with Stephanie and her campaign to ensure victory in 2020.”
– David Brown, Monmouth County Democratic Chairman
“Stephanie has stepped up and has shown community members throughout Ocean County that she is dedicated to listening to their needs and that she is committed to putting in the work to help bring change at every level of government. Stephanie and her team helped campaign for local candidates up and down the ballot in Ocean County last fall, which was greatly appreciated. Stephanie’s service to our country as a U.S. Foreign Service Officer and her work as a human rights attorney demonstrate her commitment to working tirelessly on behalf of our community, and we will be fortunate to have her represent us in Washington when we finally flip NJ-04 in November.”
– Wyatt Earp, Ocean County Democratic Chairman; Kathy Russell, Vice Chair of the Ocean County Democrats; and Marta Harrison, former Mayor of Lakewood and current Lakewood Democratic Municipal Vice Chair
“Stephanie has the background and expertise to finally bring a new generation of leadership to this district, which is long overdue. Her work as a Foreign Service Officer in the State Department and human rights advocate at the Center for Reproductive Rights stands in stark contrast to Chris Smith’s record and makes her the best candidate to take him on. Stephanie has demonstrated that she is a thoughtful and transparent leader who will put country over party for the good of her constituents. I am thrilled to support her in her bid to finally flip this seat and become the next Congresswoman in NJ-04.”
– Josh Welle, 2018 Democratic Congressional Nominee, NJ-04

Endorsements

questions.label: Is the named endorser present on the page?
questions.help: Yes when the named person or entity appears on the page. The candidate's own statements, calls to endorse, and generic supporter counts are not endorsements.

questions.label: Is the endorser name copied and separated correctly?
questions.help: endorser_name identifies the person or entity only. Title, affiliation, and jurisdiction belong in their own fields and must not sit inside the name.

questions.label: Are entity type and endorser category correct?
questions.help: entity_type is individual, organization, or unclear. endorser_category is private_individual, government_official, party_official, labor_union, media_outlet, other_organization, other_individual, or unclear. Judge both from the page alone. unclear is correct when the page gives no basis to choose; unclear is wrong when the page states the basis.

questions.label: Are title, affiliation, and jurisdiction correct or correctly null?
questions.help: These three fields are separate and nullable. They must never be combined into a generic organization field and must never be inferred. Null is correct whenever the page does not state the value.

questions.label: Does record evidence support the endorser identity?
questions.help: record_evidence is one exact name-bearing span. It may include adjacent title or jurisdiction text to make it unique. Yes when it establishes who the endorser is.

questions.label: Do record and context evidence together establish this endorsement?
questions.help: support_mode is explicit_text only when record_evidence itself states support; a bare name never qualifies. Otherwise support_mode is page_or_section_context and the context evidence must establish why the name-bearing record is an endorsement.
